fields.name: Boucle Chair

fields.name: Onyx Bookmark & Journal Clip
fields.description: A slim onyx-toned bookmark and journal clip for reading corners, notebooks, and desk rituals, bringing a quiet polished detail to daily routines.

fields.name: Deep Fuchsia Velvet Jewellery Roll
fields.description: A rich deep fuchsia velvet jewellery roll with neat compartments for rings, chains, and small keepsakes. Designed for travel, gifting, and dressing-table moments with a vivid cinematic note.

fields.name: Linen Travel Pouch

fields.description: A garnet shadow velvet jewellery roll with a deep wine-toned finish and soft internal compartments for jewellery and keepsakes. Ideal for evening rituals, travel, and refined gifting.

fields.description: A jet shimmer velvet jewellery roll with a dark luminous finish, designed for jewellery storage that feels elegant, compact, and quietly dramatic.

fields.description: A ruby lacquer velvet jewellery roll with a polished jewel-toned presence, made to hold rings, chains, and treasured pieces in a compact, giftable form.

fields.description: A jet shimmer satin sleep mask with a deep luminous finish and soft cushioned feel, created for night rituals, travel, and restful mornings.

fields.name: Ruby Lacquer Velvet Jewellery
fields.description: A ruby lacquer velvet jewellery roll with a polished jewel-toned presence, made to hold rings, chains, and treasured pieces in a compact, giftable form.

fields.name: First Light Weathered Garden Planter
fields.description: A low weathered stone planter from the First Light seasonal story, made for herbs, clipped greenery, and quiet garden thresholds.

fields.name: Midsummer Glow Outdoor Lantern
fields.description: A handled antique brass lantern from the Midsummer Glow story, designed to warm terraces, pathways, and long evening tables.

fields.name: Spring Meadow Stripe Outdoor Cushion
fields.description: A weather-minded cushion in a soft sage stripe from the Spring Meadow story, bringing relaxed comfort to benches, sofas, and garden rooms.

fields.name: High Summer Acacia Garden Tray
fields.description: A smoked acacia serving tray from the High Summer table story, made for iced drinks, small plates, and garden supper details.

fields.name: Early Spring Deep Green Seed Tin
fields.description: A deep green seed tin from the Early Spring story, with tidy internal dividers for packets, notes, labels, and seasonal planting rituals.

fields.name: Harvest Season Olive Garden Apron
fields.description: A durable olive canvas apron from the Harvest Season story, with generous pockets for secateurs, twine, tags, and everyday garden tools.

fields.name: Midsummer House Rattan Garden Sofa
fields.description: A generous honey-rattan garden sofa with natural linen cushions, created for the long, unhurried afternoons of the Midsummer House story.

fields.name: Spring Morning Garden Armchair
fields.description: A deep outdoor armchair in weathered oak with oatmeal cushions, inspired by clear Spring Morning light and quiet coffee on the terrace.

fields.name: Golden Hour Acacia Dining Table
fields.description: A six-seat smoked acacia dining table with a softly slatted top, designed for Golden Hour suppers and relaxed summer entertaining.

fields.name: May Blossom Garden Bistro Set
fields.description: A chalk-white bistro table and two chairs from the May Blossom story, perfectly scaled for balconies, courtyards, and rose-filled corners.

fields.name: Summer Garden Twelve-Piece Table Set
fields.description: A twelve-piece outdoor table set in soft ivory with botanical green detailing, made for Summer Garden lunches and candlelit suppers.

fields.name: Rose Dusk Garden Pitcher & Tumbler Set
fields.description: A blush glass pitcher with four matching tumblers, designed for cordial, citrus water, and the warm final light of the Rose Dusk season.

fields.name: May Morning Blush Climbing Rose
fields.description: A romantic repeat-flowering climbing rose with layered blush-pink blooms and a light old-rose fragrance, supplied in a nursery pot ready for a sunny wall or pergola.

fields.name: First Summer Apricot Shrub Rose
fields.description: A softly scented shrub rose with full apricot blooms fading gently to cream, selected for borders, generous containers, and the first warm days of summer.

fields.name: Midsummer Pearl Patio Rose
fields.description: A compact patio rose carrying clusters of pearl-ivory flowers throughout summer, ideal for terrace pots, table-side planters, and smaller garden spaces.

fields.name: Rose Dusk Garden Rambler
fields.description: A graceful rambling rose with abundant dusk-pink rosettes, made to soften an arch, mature tree, or garden wall with a loose and romantic summer display.

fields.name: Golden Evening Pewter Garden Refreshment Set
fields.description: A hand-blown glass jug and six delicate tumblers arranged on an oval burnished pewter tray. Inspired by the Golden Evening mood, it brings warm amber light, cool shadow, and delightful ceremony to garden refreshments.

fields.name: Four Seasons Mood Coasters
fields.description: Eight reversible artisan coasters moving through Spring Soft Renewal, Summer Quiet Warmth, Autumn Velvet Dusk, and Winter Moonlit Quiet, finished with a fine burnished pewter edge.

fields.name: Impressionist Daylight Garden Placemats
fields.description: Four reversible washed-linen placemats woven in the Water Garden Haze, Rose Lantern, and Lilac Riverlight palette: water blue, lily green, blush rose, peach light, iris lilac, and soft cerulean.

fields.name: Cinematic Evening Mood Linen Napkins
fields.description: Six washed-linen dinner napkins in claret daydream, burgundy murmur, moonlit indigo, rain blue, warm gold, and ember peach, accompanied by understated burnished pewter rings for an atmospheric evening table.

fields.name: Ember Garden Alfresco BBQ Serving Set
fields.description: A burnished pewter serving platter with walnut-handled tongs and fork, a matching sauce pot, brush, and artisan condiment bowls. Inspired by the Cinematic Firelight and Seasonal Autumn palettes, it balances ember rust, warm cream, shadowed claret, and grounding natural wood for elegant outdoor cooking.

fields.name: Water Garden Haze Alfresco Dinner Plates
fields.description: Six fine porcelain dinner plates with calm linen-ivory centres and restrained impressionist rims of water blue, lily green, soft cerulean, and garden teal. Drawn directly from the Water Garden Haze and Impressionist Day palettes, each plate is finished with a whisper-thin burnished pewter line.

fields.name: Rose Lantern Alfresco Side Plates
fields.description: Six smaller porcelain side plates with pale, versatile centres and hand-painted rims of blush rose, peach light, butter glow, claret daydream, and iris lilac. Their colour story comes from Rose Lantern and the Impressionist Evening collection, softened by a fine aged-pewter edge.

fields.name: Four Seasons Etched Garden Wine Glasses
fields.description: Six fine crystal wine glasses, each engraved with a different movement of light: spring tendrils, summer ripples, autumn wind, winter frost, impressionist reflections, and a cinematic evening spiral. Clear glass and graceful stems keep the seasonal motifs subtle, luminous, and timeless.

fields.name: Water Garden Impressionist Linen Tablecloth
fields.description: A generously sized washed-linen tablecloth woven in water blue, soft cerulean, lily green, garden teal, blush rose, iris lilac, and linen ivory. Inspired by Water Garden Haze, Lilac Riverlight, and the Impressionist Day family, its painterly passages capture reflected garden light without overpowering the table.

fields.name: Morning & Evening Impressionist Tea Towels
fields.description: Two absorbent washed-linen tea towels expressing a complete day: Morning combines water blue, leaf light, peach light, and linen ivory; Evening moves into blush rose, claret daydream, warm gold, and lilac shadow. Both reference the Impressionist, Morning, and Evening Moods Board families.

fields.name: Firelight Impressionist Double Oven Gloves
fields.description: A thick quilted double oven glove with two matching mitts for safely carrying hot alfresco dishes. The ember rust, warm gold, terracotta, cream, and claret-shadow weave is inspired by the Cinematic Firelight palette, with reinforced heat-resistant palms and carefully bound edges.

fields.name: Lilac Riverlight Tasselled Garden Parasol
fields.description: A small handheld sun parasol in matte cotton-silk, washed with iris lilac, water blue, soft cerulean, blush mist, and linen ivory. Inspired by Lilac Riverlight and the Impressionist Day collection, it has a polished wood handle, delicate tonal fringe, and a softly moving tassel for personal garden shade.

fields.name: Golden Evening Burnished Pewter Napkin Rings
fields.description: Six substantial hand-finished pewter napkin rings, each carrying a quiet low-relief motif: spring tendril, summer ripple, autumn wind, winter frost curl, impressionist water reflection, and cinematic evening spiral. Warm highlights and softly aged recesses draw from Golden Evening while remaining beautifully timeless.

fields.name: Marie Antoinette Garden Etched Champagne Coupes
fields.description: Six shallow crystal champagne coupes with graceful, salon-inspired proportions and the collection's signature seasonal engraving: spring tendril, summer ripple, autumn wind, winter frost, impressionist reflection, and cinematic evening spiral. Dappled garden light creates prismatic sparkle without disturbing their quiet elegance.

fields.name: Dappled Light Seasonal Etched Champagne Flutes
fields.description: Six slender crystal champagne flutes engraved with the same six movements of the Garden glass collection. Their narrow bowls, fine stems, and translucent swirls catch points of dappled sunlight, blending Seasonal, Impressionist, and Cinematic moods into a luminous celebration set.

fields.name: Noir Shadow Wool Throw
fields.description: A deeply tactile charcoal wool throw for firelit terraces and quiet evening rooms. Inspired by the Noir and Midnight Moods Board families, its near-black weave gathers warm amber light while Blue Black and Moon Violet shadows give it cinematic depth. Finished with a softly fringed edge.

fields.name: Cinematic Grain Woven Garden Hat
fields.description: A refined wide-brim garden hat in tightly woven natural fibre, shaped with a structured crown and softly rolled edge. Dappled golden light brings out its honey-grain texture, while a narrow Noir Shadow grosgrain ribbon links it to the Cinematic and Midnight Moods Board families.

fields.colour_finish: Linen Whisper, Pale Cream, Soft Meadow
fields.name: Meadow Skirt Set
fields.description: Drawn from an original Boutique House sketch, c.1980-81. A countryside skirt set remembered from summers long ago, reimagined in quiet, softly worn colourways.

fields.colour_finish: Linen Whisper, Oyster, Peacock Teal, Midnight Ink
fields.name: Riviera Trouser Set
fields.description: Drawn from an original Boutique House sketch, c.1980-81. Effortless wide-leg tailoring with a soft Riviera lightness, designed to outlast trends.

fields.colour_finish: Pale Cream, Ivory Silk, Noir Shadow, Rose Mist
fields.name: Poet Skirt Ensemble
fields.description: Drawn from an original Boutique House sketch, c.1980-81. A romantic blouse and skirt ensemble inspired by favourite clothes, handwritten notes, and old light.

fields.name: Cloud Paper Cotton Blouse
fields.description: A crisp white cotton blouse with a cinematic mirror portrait mood, added to Vintage Notes as a softly modern companion piece.

fields.colour_finish: Pale Cream, Linen Whisper, Peacock Teal, Sapphire Depth
fields.name: The Garden Canopy Umbrella
fields.description: A refined fringed garden umbrella designed to bring softness, shade, and timeless elegance to outdoor spaces. Available in Pale Cream, Linen Whisper, Peacock Teal, and Sapphire Depth.
